finding.title: OS Command Injection
finding.trigger: attacker-controlled input in file causing printf to misinterpret data as a command
finding.assumptions: The attacker can control the content of the file, and the file content is treated as a command by printf.

finding.title: OS Command Injection
finding.trigger: attacker-controlled input in file path causing processFile to misinterpret data as a command
finding.assumptions: The attacker can control the file paths returned by glob, and processFile treats these paths as commands.
